title: PSPLIB J30 scheduling benchmark
summary: Across accepted checkpoints under one frozen PSPLIB J30 contract, Evölther reduced the lower-is-better scheduling score from 14.312 at baseline to 12.087, and Evölther 2.0 reduced it further to 10.108 while preserving feasibility on all 80 instances.
problem_statement: Find a deterministic activity-priority rule for serial schedule generation that reduces makespan gap against proven PSPLIB J30 optima while preserving precedence and renewable-resource feasibility.

evaluation_contract.summary: Candidates are scored on 80 frozen PSPLIB J30 single-mode RCPSP instances. Every evaluated instance has a proven optimal makespan, and schedules must satisfy precedence constraints, renewable-resource capacities, finite priority scores, and deterministic eligible-activity selection.

website.card_summary: A deterministic scheduling policy reaches a 29.37% lower governed score while preserving feasibility across the frozen portfolio.

website.score_note: The score is the frozen evaluation contract for this public PSPLIB J30 subset. It is not a runtime benchmark and it is not a claim over all RCPSP instances.
